info.title: HELIOS API v1 — people, daily tasks and safe publication
info.description: Scoped read, personnel and task preparation/publication slices; legacy execution remains limited to existing legacy fixtures. All protected routes require active tenant membership. Directors see their tenant, master/PTO need active project membership, workers additionally need own active employee assignment for projects/tasks. Own employee profile may be read without assignment. Details hide inaccessible rows with 404. Counts use authorized rows. Overview uses civil day in tenant timezone with half-open timestamp bounds. reviewedReportsForDay means accepted_quantity IS NOT NULL, including zero, not completed tasks. currentOpenShifts is current across days. Null acceptedQuantity means no report in the group has been reviewed. No mixed-unit sum. Unavailable metrics are intentional capability declarations. Phase02a adds director-only people commands with durable requestId replay, expectedVersion, immutable yes/no admission evidence, project assignments and crews. Document references are metadata only. Current admission requires latest attempt/template and exact active qualification id/version, inclusive tenant civil-date expiry. Phase02b adds project catalogs, strict managed drafts, immutable front checks and atomic director publication. Legacy create is retired410; managed tasks reject legacy sync/report mutations409 before replay/effects. 52 v1 operations plus one deprecated legacy creation route. Execution/files/offline/material/ID/full pilot remain pending.
